name: Undermind
summary: AI research assistant that reads full texts and figures to find and cite relevant papers.
description: Undermind runs in-depth searches of the scientific literature, reading full texts and figures and citing every source, then keeps results in a library that grows as research continues. It can be connected to AI agents such as Claude and ChatGPT.

howToUse.title: Open Undermind
howToUse.description: Open Undermind and sign up, then describe the research question. It asks follow-up questions.

howToUse.title: Search the literature
howToUse.description: Undermind runs searches across the scientific literature, reading the full texts and the figures.

howToUse.title: Check every source
howToUse.description: Every statement keeps citing its source, so you can open that source and check the paper.

howToUse.title: Keep a growing library
howToUse.description: Keep the results in the library. It grows as the research continues, and the account can be connected to Claude or ChatGPT.
